Maintainer / autore del fork: **RedHunt07** · License: **MIT**. Original Voice Loop code by ZG2017;

see NOTICE.md.
Hands-free Italian/English conversations for DSH. Speak, pause for 1.7 seconds, and y
our prompt is submitted. After the final spoken reply, listening resumes using the same microphone s
tream. A compact composer dock keeps the native chat, tools and DSH-provided Think output visible. T
his displays reasoning exposed by DSH, not private model reasoning.
Guida italiana · npm package · GitHub Package · Credits and licenses
## Compatibility
Tested: **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**, Node.js 22+, Linux web profile. Other DSH releases, operating systems an
d browsers need validation. Microphone access requires localhost or HTTPS and browser permission. Us
e headphones to reduce loudspeaker echo triggering spoken interruption.

No backend, global transcript preferences or background services are installed automatically.
## Optional local backend
Extract the source archive and open its directory. Prerequisites: `python3`, uv, and `ffmpeg` on PAT
H. Setup creates an isolated Python 3.12 environment, downloading the interpreter through uv if nece
ssary, and downloads approximately 3.1 GB of pinned Whisper/Piper model files. Review NOTICE.md firs
ary, and downloads approximately 3.1 GB of pinned Whisper/Piper model files. Review NOTICE.md first.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Whisper large-v3 can be slow on CPU. On Linux with a compatible NVIDIA CUDA 12 driver and sufficient
VRAM (tested on a 16 GB GPU), use `setup --device cuda` instead. Setup installs pinned CUDA librari
es inside its environment, not system drivers or system packages.
Keep the foreground process running; Ctrl+C stops it. Data lives at `~/.local/share/dsh-voice-conver
sation`; `--data-dir PATH` overrides it. Whisper uses the standard Hugging Face cache. Inspect confi
guration and service availability with:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The backend binds only to `127.0.0.1:8766`. DSH must run on the same machine; its host proxies the a
udio. Browser-origin requests are rejected. Local processes can access this unauthenticated backend;
keep the port private. For remote browser access, DSH still needs HTTPS for microphone permissions.
## Use and configure
Enable Voice Mode once in a DSH chat and allow the microphone. Select local recognition/synthesis. C
hoose `paola` for Italian speech or `lessac` for English. Recognition automatically chooses between
Italian and English; output uses the selected voice and does not automatically switch language.
The dock shows listening, processing and speaking. Responses are read only after the agent finishes;
intermediate tool-step text is skipped. Speak over a reply to interrupt it. Approval requests remai
n in the normal chat and can require a click. Close Voice Mode to release the microphone.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and limits
The supplied backend processes audio in memory and does not save recordings or transcript logs. Tran
scribed prompts and replies remain in DSH's normal session history and follow the selected chat mode
l's data handling. Remote speech endpoints receive audio/text when explicitly configured. Setup need
s internet; cached local speech models run offline afterward. The chat model can still use a remote
t; cached local speech models run offline afterward. The chat model can still use a remote provider.
Pause detection and barge-in use audio energy, not semantic end-of-turn detection. Room noise, micro
phone gain and echo affect them. Recordings are capped at 120 seconds; audio requests time out after
90 seconds; playback has a watchdog and can truncate unusually long replies. The voice prompt reque
sts concise answers while active.
Tests simulate microphone/audio events and cover VAD, the dock, consecutive replies, tool-step filte
ring, TTS failure, interrupted synthesis, agent errors, and missing playback completion. Real-room m
icrophone testing is still required before a stable public release. Version 0.1.1 is an initial rele
ing is still required before a stable public release. Version 0.1.1 is an initial release candidate.
## Develop and publish
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`prepack` rebuilds and tests. Browser code is hand-written JavaScript. Python dependency locks and m
odel revisions are included. There are no npm install lifecycle hooks. An explicit file allowlist ex
cludes models, environments, credentials and session history.
[该节后续省略]
### 0.1.2 catalog compatibility
The 0.1.2 package adds the `dsh-plugin` / `deepseek-harness` npm keywords and emits a direct `export
function apply(ctx, config)` declaration in the built entry. This matches the entry style of listed
plugins while preserving the same function implementation. It is a precaution for static discovery;
the Hub scanner code is not public, so the exclusion reason remains unconfirmed.
